senses.sense_definition: A twentieth-century philosophical movement emphasizing the uniqueness of each human existence in freely making its self-defining choices.

examples.text: The <w>existentialism</w> movement gained significant popularity among intellectuals in post-war Europe.
Many students find the core tenets of <w>existentialism</w> challenging to apply to their daily lives.

senses.sense_definition: The philosophical views of a particular thinker associated with the existentialist movement.

examples.text: Scholars often debate the differences between the <w>existentialism</w> of Sartre and that of Kierkegaard.
One must distinguish between various <w>existentialism</w> interpretations when studying modern philosophy.
